children: She brings finance experience across Godrej Consumer Products, Accord Healthcare and Ford Motor Company
Lakshmi Janaki has been appointed Chief Financial Officer of Zydus Healthcare South Africa, effective September 2026. She is based in Johannesburg, according to a LinkedIn post by Janaki.
Janaki joins Zydus from Godrej Consumer Products, where she served as Financial Planning and Analysis Manager in South Africa from December 2023.

Before joining Godrej Consumer Products, she was Finance Manager at Accord Healthcare in Johannesburg from September 2021 to February 2024. She previously worked as Senior Financial Associate at Ford Motor Company in Chennai from September 2016 to September 2021, where she worked on reasonability audits across North America, Africa and Europe.
Janaki began her career as an Article Assistant at Manohar Chowdhry & Associates, Chartered Accountants, in Chennai, where she worked on statutory and tax audits from March 2013 to March 2016.
Janaki  qualified as a Chartered Accountant with the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India and holds a master's degree in Accounting and Finance (ACCA).
